detail-recipes.name: Brown hair
detail-recipes.summary: Warm mid brown hair with dark roots and soft tan strands

steps.note: Two coats, thinned, keeping a clean line where the hair meets the skin.
Let it settle between the strands and keep it off the face.
Long strokes along the strands, leaving the roots and partings dark.
Fine lines on the strand tops round the crown and fringe only.

detail-recipes.name: Red and ginger hair
detail-recipes.summary: Auburn to ginger hair kept warm, from a red brown base up to soft orange strands

steps.note: Cover all of the hair in smooth, even coats.
Into the deepest strands and the hairline, not over everything.
Along the raised strands, more of it for ginger and less for auburn.
A few strand tips only, as bright orange or yellow looks false.

detail-recipes.name: Black hair
detail-recipes.summary: Shiny black hair from an off black with cool blue grey strands

steps.note: A softened black leaves room for the highlights to show.
Broad strands across the crown and wherever the light falls.
Thinner, shorter strands inside the first band.
Thinned over the whole area to soften the steps and add a sheen.

detail-recipes.name: Chestnut horse coat
detail-recipes.summary: An even red brown horse coat with warm, glossy highlights on the muscles

steps.note: Over the whole horse, mane and tail included.
All over the coat, lifting any pools on the flanks before they dry.
Shoulder, hip, neck and top of the head, leaving the belly darker.
Small patches on the tops of the muscles for a glossy coat.

detail-recipes.name: Bay horse coat
detail-recipes.summary: A rich brown horse with a black mane, tail and lower legs

steps.note: Over the body and head, and do not worry about the legs yet.
Over the brown to deepen the gaps between the muscles.
Back over the shoulder, hip and neck, leaving the shadows dark.
Mane, tail and the legs below the knees, painted last to cover any slips.

detail-recipes.name: Dapple grey horse coat
detail-recipes.summary: A pale grey horse with soft round dapples and a darker head and legs

steps.note: Over the whole horse, as this grey shows between the dapples.
Small rounded patches over the body with thin gaps of mid grey between.
Inside the dapples on the tops of the muscles only.
Thinned over the muzzle, lower legs and mane to darken them.
